content: Řḥukkam imeqqranen n Suliman d řwulat nnes
Tuɣa ajeǧid Suliman d ajeǧid x marra Israil.
Ina tuɣa d řḥukkam nnes imeqqranen: Ɛazarya, mmis n Ṣaduq, tuɣa-t d akehhan d amezwaru.
Iliḥuraf d Axiya, iḥenjiren n Cica, tuɣa aten d imariren. Yaḥucafaṭ, mmis n Axilud, tuɣa-t d amarir amezwaru.
Banaya, mmis n Yahuyadaɛ, tuɣa-t x řɛeskar. Ṣaduq d Abyatar tuɣa aten d ikehhanen.
Ɛazarya, mmis n Natan, tuɣa-t x řwulat. Zabud, mmis n Natan, tuɣa-t d akehhan d ameddukkeř n ujeǧid.
Axicar tuɣa-t x tzeddiɣt n ujeǧid. Aduniram, mmis n Abda tuɣa-t x ljizya.
Suliman ɣares tenɛac n řwulat x marra Israil, inni ibedden x řeɛweč n ujeǧid d taddart nnes. X kuř ijj s uyur nnes deg useggʷas, tuɣa xas ad t iksi.
Ina d ismawen nsen:
Mmis n Ḥur x idurar n Ifrayim.
Mmis n Daqar di Maqas u di Caɛalubbim, Bayt-Cams d Ilun-Bayt-Ḥanan.
Mmis n Ḥasad di Arubut. Netta tuɣa ɣares Suku d marra tammurt n Ḥafir.
Mmis n Abinadab ɣares marra tiwririn n Dur. Tafat, yeǧis n Suliman, tuɣa-tt ɣares d tamɣart.
Baɛna, mmis n Axilud, ɣares Taɛnak, Majiddu d marra Bayt-Can i iǧan ɣar Ṣurtan, swadday n Yazraɛil, zi Bayt-Can ař Abal-Maḥula, ař uɣezdis nneɣni n Yuqmaɛam.

Mmis n Jabar tuɣa di Ramut-Jilɛad. Netta ɣares dcurat n Ya’ir, mmis n Manassa, tinni iǧan di Jilɛad. Tuɣa ɣares uřa d jjihet n Arjub, tenni di Bacan, settin n tineddam mɣarent s řḥiḍ u s weɛmud n nnḥas.
Axinadab, mmis n Ɛiddu, ɣares Maḥanayim.
Aximaɛaṣ tuɣa-t d lwali di Naftali. Netta yiwi uřa Basimat, yeǧis n Suliman, d tamɣart nnes.
Baɛna, mmis n Hucai, tuɣa-t d lwali di Acir u di Baɛalut.
Yahucafaṭ, mmis n Faruḥ, tuɣa-t d lwali di Issakar.
Cimɛi, mmis n Iyla, tuɣa-t d lwali di Binyamin.
Jabar, mmis n Uri, tuɣa-t d lwali di temmurt n Jilɛad, tammurt n Siḥun, ajeǧid n Imuriyyen, u n Ɛuj, ajeǧid n Bacan. Netta tuɣa d ayenni n lwali di temmurt nni.
Tuɣa řgens n Yahuda d Israil s waṭṭas am yijdi ɣar tma n řebḥar, ammu aṭṭas. Nitni ccin, swin u farḥen.
